derivation:
apply CoalgHom.coe_linearMap_injective
exact MonoidAlgebra.lhom_ext' fun g => LinearMap.ext_ring (h g)
explanation: `MonoidAlgebra.lhom_ext'` proves equality of linear maps out of a monoid algebra from equality on its generators. Applying it to the underlying linear maps and using injectivity of the coercion from coalgebra homomorphisms gives the stated result; the current proof already does this.
